newsitem.title: USA: Innovex shares sold by Vinik-led group.
newsitem.headline: Innovex shares sold by Vinik-led group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik on Friday said it sold 161,000 common shares in Innovex Inc during December.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its stake dropped to 5.4 percent from 6.5 percent held on December 19. Still, the number of shares held after the sale rose to 766,000, reflecting a two-for-one stock split on December 24.
After the split, the company's outstanding shares rose to 14,293,554 from 7,146,777, the filing said.

Of the 161,000 common shares sold between December 20 and December 26 -- at prices ranging from $28.6518 to $29.2636 each -- 80,000 sold between December 20 and December 23 reflected the 2-for-1 split.
Innovex, based in Hopkins, Minn., makes precision electromagnetic products.
